UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT

ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S REPLY CONCERNING EARLY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE

I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:

1.	I am the Plaintiff in this action. I have personal knowledge of the facts stated in this Declaration.

2.	On July 31, 2026, I transmitted written settlement proposals to Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (“NCMEC”) and Katie Hall.

3.	The proposals required no monetary payment or admission of wrongdoing. I offered to bear the deposition recording costs. In exchange, NCMEC and Hall would provide sworn testimony concerning the April 22, 2026 letters and limited document production, followed by releases of the covered claims upon satisfaction of the agreements’ conditions.

4.	The proposed agreements did not require either Defendant to corroborate my allegations, testify favorably to me, or produce any particular evidentiary result. The contemplated releases were not conditioned on whether truthful, materially responsive testimony favored my claims.

5.	The proposals provided for acceptance by August 14, 2026. Neither NCMEC nor Hall accepted them.

I declare under penalty of perjury pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1746 that the foregoing is true and correct.

Executed on November 9, 2026.

Marvelle J. Ballentine
